newsitem.title: USA: PanEnergy enters natgas plant agreement.
newsitem.headline: PanEnergy enters natgas plant agreement.

text.p: PanEnergy Corp said on Wednesday that it signed definitive agreements with the Associated Electric Cooperative Inc to share the construction cost of a 250-MegaWatt, gas-fired, combined cycle power generation plant in southeastern Missouri.
The plant's production will be jointly marketed, PanEnergy said.
Siemens AG's Siemens Power Corp will build, operate and maintain the power plant at a site on Associated Electric's transmission system near St. Francis, Missouri, the company said.
The power generation project, which was first announced in August, is scheduled to be operational in 1999.
